results.rationale: The prior ETH-only cell gains motivate separate asset/lead intercept and slope calibration. Prior result: Prior batch localized raw-market gains to ETH. Separate asset/lead calibration first. Technical rerun after creating the required output directory; no model or data change.

Prior result: Method 16: log-loss difference versus raw market 0.002681635, versus recalibration 0.002902570, versus prior ARD 0.003485884. Proceed with the separately declared hypothesis in this method, retaining all failures and the cumulative 35-method screen.
